modal.label: Modal
modal.description: Overlay modal with backdrop (rgba(0,0,0,0.9)), backdrop-click close, focus trap, and body scroll lock. Shown/hidden by toggling the observed data-layout-hidden attribute.

slots.name: content
slots.description: Modal content. MUST be a child with slot="content" — the component renders <slot name="content"> inside its backdrop; unslotted children never display. The slotted panel is unstyled light DOM: the page provides the white box, close button, and typography.

attrs.name: data-layout-hidden
attrs.description: Observed. Start with "true" (hidden). The true→false transition opens the modal; false→true closes it. The component resets it to "true" when it closes itself (backdrop click / focus-trap escape).

modal.notes: Open with el.setAttribute('data-layout-hidden', 'false'); close by setting 'true'. The data-visual-open / data-visual-closed attributes previously documented upstream are NOT implemented; upstream corrected its own docblock to data-layout-hidden in 1.19.x, matching what this registry already recorded. Modal also dispatches modal:show / modal:hide (bubbling, composed) as of 1.19.x. Trigger gotcha: umd-element-call-to-action and umd-element-card-overlay (cta-icon slot) CLONE their child link/button into shadow DOM, so document-level click delegation via e.target.closest() never sees the trigger — walk e.composedPath() instead. See LAYOUT-PATTERNS.md 'Modal' for the wiring recipe.

scroll-top.label: Scroll to Top
scroll-top.description: Floating scroll-to-top button. Appears after the user scrolls down and smoothly returns to the top when clicked.

attrs.name: data-layout-fixed
attrs.description: Fixed viewport positioning. IMPORTANT: the DS CSS (web-components.min.css) matches ONLY data-layout-fixed="true" (explicit value) or a bare `fixed` attribute — a valueless boolean data-layout-fixed does NOT match, and the button renders position:static in normal flow. Omit entirely for absolute positioning.

scroll-top.notes: Usually placed once per page, near the end of the body. To pin it, use data-layout-fixed="true" (NOT a valueless data-layout-fixed — that won't match the CSS and the button stays static in flow). DS fixed default is right:40px; bottom:10vh; z-index:9999; 52x52. Override right/bottom in your page <style> to reposition (e.g. right:24px; bottom:24px for a 24px viewport inset).

logo.label: Boxed Logo
logo.description: Boxed logo display for partner logos, department logos, or sponsor grids.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Optional text content alongside the logo.

attrs.name: data-visual
attrs.description: Add a border around the logo box.

logo.notes: This is umd-element-logo, NOT the site header `slot="logo"` anchor. Use this for logo grids, not site branding.

media-gif.label: Accessible GIF
media-gif.description: Wraps an animated GIF with a play/pause toggle for accessible motion control (respects prefers-reduced-motion).
media-gif.notes: Required whenever you embed an animated GIF on a page — users must be able to pause motion.

events-date.label: Event Date Lockup
events-date.description: Formatted date sign / event date lockup that renders start and end dates in a responsive, prominent format. Typically paired with an event title. See registry-cards.json for the fuller entry — duplicated here as part of the layout utility set.

slots.name: start-date-iso
slots.description: Event start. The component reads this slot's TEXT CONTENT, not the datetime attribute — utilities/date/parseDateFromElement.ts does Date.parse(element.textContent). Put the full ISO 8601 string in the element's text.

slots.name: end-date-iso
slots.description: Event end. The component reads this slot's TEXT CONTENT, not the datetime attribute — utilities/date/parseDateFromElement.ts does Date.parse(element.textContent). Put the full ISO 8601 string in the element's text. Always supply it: omitting this optional slot makes the component render the literal string 'undefined' in the date line. For a single-day event repeat the start value, which is what the DS QA site does.

events-date.notes:
DATE SLOTS, corrected 2026-09-22: the examples here previously showed Human readable. That is WRONG and renders silently bad dates — parseDateFromElement reads textContent, so the human-readable text was parsed. 'April 15' parses as year 2001 (a Sunday) and a date with no time renders 12:00am. Verified against the DS QA site, which passes
2026-02-09T00:00:00.000
. IMPORTANT: slot names are `start-date-iso` and `end-date-iso` (NOT `date-start-iso` / `date-end-iso` as shown in the upstream JSDoc — that's a documentation bug). The component queries the former via Slots.name.DATE_START_ISO which resolves to `start-date-iso`.
